errors.evidence: The x-axis has no label. The tick marks represent years, but there is no axis title "Jahr" (Year).

errors.text_span: Zwischen 1985 und 1995 fällt sie auf etwa 2,6%
errors.evidence: This phrasing suggests the value falls *to* 2.6% by 1995. However, the value in 1995 is approximately 1.8%. The line passes through 2.6% around 1988, but does not end at that value for the period.

errors.text_span: dann steil auf etwa 1,5% im Jahr 2000
errors.evidence: The value in the year 2000 is approximately 1.6%, not 1.5%.

errors.text_span: Sie bleibt bis etwa 2010 weitgehend stabil
errors.evidence: The line shows a clear, albeit gradual, downward trend between 2000 (approx. 1.6%) and 2010 (approx. 1.4%). Describing this as 'largely stable' is an oversimplification.

errors.text_span: steigt bis etwa 1,5% im Jahr 2022 wieder leicht an
errors.evidence: The final value of the line, at the rightmost end of the axis (c. 2022), is approximately 1.7%, not 1.5%.
The reference line at 2% is dashed ('gestrichelt' in German), not dotted ('gepunktete').
